responsibility: Implements GCC’s generic tree/GIMPLE body duplication engine for inlining, cloning, versioning, and related function-body remapping tasks. It remaps declarations, SSA names, blocks, EH regions, callgraph edges, debug information, and CFG/GIMPLE statements from a source function into a destination context; supports expression-level inlining, type duplication, and whole-function copying; and provides the machinery on which the inliner and several body-cloning transforms build.
same_name_distinction: Implements the body-copying and remapping engine used for inlining, cloning, versioning, and expression-level inlining, including declaration/type/SSA/EH/debug remap behavior. Unlike gcc/tree-inline.h, this file contains the operational algorithms rather than the control structures and API declarations.
